liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Comes a Time** (3 reviews): Comes a Time is called a nice treat; Comes a Time is called amazing [21][22][24]
- **Mississippi Half Step** (2 reviews): Half Step opening the second set rocks the house; Half Step opening set two was rare by then [17][19]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Bertha is singled out as strong [21]
- **Queen Jane Approximately** (1 review): Queen Jane and Dire Wolf are highlights of the first set [17]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Reviewer thought the set was over after this song, but it continued [19]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): UJB was darn near perfect, with the reviewer still raving about Comes a Time during it [23]
- **Jam** (1 review): Second-set jam began with Vince playing a fugue-like calliope and circus organ; Jerry's lead bridged it abruptly [26]
- **Attics of My Life** (1 review): Attics is singled out as amazing, alongside Comes a Time [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-09-16.nak300.gidley.121949.flac2448** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 159 min [1]. Said about its sound: Some mic bumps and brief left-channel static during Space, attenuated with Wavelab [1]
- **gd1991-09-16.153419.mtx.photoleon.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 162 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1991-09-16.mtx.haugh.100910.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 164 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1991-09-16.149653.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 159 min [5]
- **gd91-09-16.bk4011.brennecke-young.4868.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 165 min; rated 4.62/5 by 8 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is quite good; individual shn files downloaded fine but the full-show zip did not; Audience singalongs come through like backing vocals; some rough playing at times [20][27]
- **gd91-09-16.sbd.kowalski.525.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 157 min; rated 4.67/5 by 9 [13]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds crisp and clean; Reviewer calls it a superior soundboard for 1991; Soundboard is very crisp, better than the audience recording on the site [17][21][23][26]

## Around the show

- Taper seats: Section 2 Row U for set one, Section 3 Row T for set two [18]
- Room seemed oversold and packed; reviewer watched from the first walkaround on Jerry's side, where Jerry dominated [19]
- Garcia's playing and singing are solid across both sets [22]
- Band rested on the 15th, so they came back fresh; first set stayed high-energy after Roses [23]
- Soundboard download vanished; reviewer glad audience recordings were restored to the site [24]
- One year after Brent, the show lacks the verve he brought [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-09-16.nak300.gidley.121949.flac2448**: taped by Ted Gidley; transferred by Andrew F.; source: OTS AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300 w/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MXS 90/100, w/no Dolby. Taped by Ted Gidley. [1]. Also: Nak 300 recording by Gidley, with patches from ID-94246 for crowd at end of Queen Jane and during Space [1]
- **gd1991-09-16.153419.mtx.photoleon.flac1644**: source: A photoLeon Matrix [2]. Also: Matrix made in Adobe Audition by Joe Noel from FOB by Brotman and Metchick, OTS by Gastwirt, and SBD by Pearson and Healy [2]
- **gd1991-09-16.mtx.haugh.100910.flac16**: transferred by Dan Haugh; source: SBD(SHNID=525) + AUD(SHNID=97389) [3]
- **gd1991-09-16.149653.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  April 21, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [5]. Also: Soundboard recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; multiple master sets combined to make the show complete [5]
- **gd91-09-16.bk4011.brennecke-young.4868.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB B&K 4011 (hand-held, sets recorded from different positions) -> Canari cables -> Neumann Phantom Power ->Sony TCD D10 Pro 2 Modified-> DAT @48k [7]. Also: Audience recording by Clay Brennecke and James Young, front of board, using B&K 4011 cardioids handheld at 110 degrees; Chain ran through a Neumann BS 48i-2 phantom supply into a modified Sony TCD-D10 DAT machine [18]
- **gd91-09-16.sbd.kowalski.525.sbeok.shnf**: source: sbd> dat> cd> eac> shn [13]
